notes: s001 τό is the article of the adverbial τὸ λοιπόν and is left unrepresented under rule 23.
καθὼς καί: the ASV writes no correlative 'so', so καθώς keeps 'even as' and the answering καί takes the word the ASV does write for it, 'also' (rules 65, 82).

The supplied 'it is' rides with πρός as the clause's prepositional predicate, the clause expressing no subject at all (rules 53, 68); reading it off the English word order onto a subject would be the failure rule 53 names.
